cues: Every variable lives at an address in memory.
A pointer is a variable that stores such an address.
Declare p as a pointer to an int, and set it to ampersand n, the address of n.
text: Every variable lives at an address in memory. A pointer is a variable that stores such an address. Declare p as a pointer to an int, and set it to ampersand n, the address of n. Now p points at n.
